phaseDefinition: Fraction of each clip's declared source interval, sampled at equal time steps.
hipsDegDefinition: Left, right pairs of flexion and adduction angles in degrees. Positive indicates flexion/adduction.
displayFrame: Recorded landmarks retain lateral and vertical sway in a fixed lab frame. Linear forward progression is removed for in-place playback.

clips.label: Preoperative hip OA
clips.source: Bertaux A. et al. Scientific Data 9, 399 (2022). CC BY 4.0.
clips.notes: Participant HOA001, preoperative right hip OA (KL 4). Two successive recorded right foot strikes bound this stride. Shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles use Vicon Plug-in Gait segment endpoints. Hands, heels and forefeet use surface markers. Head, neck and chest use marker midpoints. The signed hip angles come from the source Plug-in Gait output.

clips.label: Hip capacity · 100%
clips.phaseLabel: Right heel strike to right heel strike
clips.landmarkMethod: OpenSim forward kinematics of 29 published coordinates. Joint centers use child frames. Pelvis is the hip midpoint. Chest, hands and toes use segment mass centers. Heels use calcaneus origins. Neck and head are torso-fixed display landmarks at 4.5 and 18.1 cm above the shoulder midpoint.
clips.replayMethod: Right heel strike aligned, symmetric periodic gait. Constant forward progression removed. Ground reaction and equal-weight mean activation of the three right gluteus medius bundles are published simulation outputs.
clips.scenario: Bilateral peak isometric force capacity varied for muscles acting on hip flexion–extension. The remaining task and objective settings are shared.
